meta.name: Narrative
meta.description: Pure storytelling — no stats, no dice, no skill checks. Characters, prose and consequences, with a world that moves through real days and hours.

narrativeVibe: Literary, character-driven storytelling. Vivid sensory prose, natural dialogue, emotional honesty. Outcomes follow from character, choice and consequence — never from dice. Let quiet moments breathe and let time passing matter.
scenario: A story about people. This world runs on narrative alone: no stats, no skill checks, no combat math. What happens next follows from who the characters are and what they choose. Time is real and keeps moving — hours pass within a scene, days turn over, and the calendar advances as the story unfolds. Treat every event as an opportunity for character and consequence rather than a roll of the dice.
start: Open on {{user}} in an ordinary moment that quietly matters — somewhere with texture and a person worth knowing, a small tension in the air. Establish the time of day, the day of the week and the date naturally in the prose. Then hand the scene to {{user}} and follow where they lead.

trackers.label: Day
trackers.effects: The current in-game day number — how much time has passed since the story began.
trackers.rules: Starts at 1. Increase by 1 each time a full day passes in the story. Never decrease.

trackers.label: Day Name
trackers.effects: The current day of the week.
trackers.rules: Use exactly one of: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday or Sunday. Advance by one each time the day number increases.

trackers.label: Time
trackers.rules: Write it in 12-hour format, e.g. "10:00 AM", "1:20 PM". Advance it as in-story minutes and hours pass — a scene spanning a few hours should move the clock by that much.

trackers.label: Date
trackers.rules: Write it as "D Mon YYYY", e.g. "1 Jan 2027", "14 Feb 2027". Advance it in lockstep with the day number.

npcTrackers.label: Relationship
npcTrackers.effects: How this character is bonded to the hero (stranger, friend, rival, lover...); the bond gates what they will do for each other.
npcTrackers.rules: Deepens or breaks with shared trials.

npcTrackers.label: Mood
npcTrackers.effects: Current emotional state; a hostile mood closes dialogue options while a warm one opens them.
npcTrackers.rules: Shifts with how the hero treats them.
